title.purpose: An item's name: a request, a piece of work, a lesson.

label.purpose: Keys and table heads; Meta (same size, tabular) for times and counts.

mono.purpose: Literal strings only: addresses, character counts, codes.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every state change (150 ms) and arriving block (200 ms).

motion.name: star-twinkle
motion.value: a 0.4 s dip to 80% size and 75% opacity every 7 s
motion.purpose: The brand's signature move, on the north star only. Still under reduced motion.

motion.name: orbit-drift
motion.purpose: The orbit's nodes drifting. Still under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a view: approve, add a person, sign in.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>Approve this copy</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #0f766e); color: var(--color-on-accent, #fff); font: 600 14px/20px Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #0d625b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action: decline, change, chat with an employee.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #7d878f); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1f2328); font: 600 14px/20px Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(31 35 40 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled field; errors in words below it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 12px/16px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-2, #4a545d); } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #7d878f); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-inset, #f6f8f8); color: var(--color-ink, #1f2328); font: 400 16px/24px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-focus, #0f766e); outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #0f766e); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Status
components.description: A dot plus a word: the only way state is shown.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 500 12px/16px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-2, #4a545d); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-warn-dot, #e0a73a); }

components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--color-bar, #16191d); font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { color: #fff; font: 700 20px/1 Manrope, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-link { color: var(--color-bar-ink-2, #c3cad0); font: 500 14px/20px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-link:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-current { color: #2dd4bf; border-bottom-color: #2dd4bf; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A calm, light workspace under a charcoal bar, where the one bright thing is what needs you. The Northlight mark, a four-point north star, sits at the centre of the team page: the business is the ring, its AI employees sit on the orbit, and the star twinkles now and then. Everything else is paper-quiet: cool neutrals, one accent, status as a dot plus a word.

Dark mode is charcoal, not light inverted: a charcoal ground, elevation by surface colour, bright teal as the accent with charcoal type on it.
keyCharacteristics: One accent per theme: teal ink on light, bright teal on dark. The only full teal on a light screen is the north star.
Charcoal appears in the top bar, the avatars and the sign-in cover only.
No shadows, no glass, no gradients: elevation is surface colour.
Words carry state; colour only repeats it.

rules.name: The One Star Rule
rules.body: On a light screen the only full teal is the north star; everything interactive uses the darker teal ink.

rules.name: The Dot-and-Word Rule
rules.body: Every status is a coloured dot plus a word ("Needs you", "Done", "Problem"); colour is never the only signal. Dots use the design's state colours; their words use the darker text variants (ok #157a51, warn #855700, danger #b53939).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are sentence case; no eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.

dos: Do say what approving does and what it does not.
Do show load failures as failures with Try again, never as an empty list.
Do keep every count next to words that say what it counts.
donts: Don't use shadows, glass, glow or gradient text.
Don't put full teal on a light surface outside the north star.
Don't call an employee an agent, bot or chatbot, or use exclamation marks.
